extension.summary: Universal Screensaver with video plugin source support
Universal Screensaver with video plugin source support
extension.description: The Universal Screensaver displays a slideshow of images using various transition effects. Sources include video fanart, music fanart, a custom image folder, or a video plugin path. Plugin images are cached locally.
